checkpoint_review: The Router's verdicts are largely accurate but require stricter interpretation of 'structured typography'. The Router marked 'Folded card... with structured typography' as false, which is correct because the text is gibberish. However, the Router marked 'Food and beverage items organized by category' as untestable. I disagree; since the text is gibberish, it is definitively NOT organized into food categories, so this should be marked 'false' (missing) rather than untestable. The presence of gibberish negates the functional component entirely. The Router correctly identified that the aesthetic/theme checkpoints passed, but these are superficial compared to the functional failure.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified 'text_gibberish' as a severity 5 artifact. This is the defining defect. The 'structural_collapse' of text alignment (severity 3) is also well-noted. The 'texture_anomaly' (severity 2) is consistent with AI generation softness. The Expert 'image_text_auditor' confirms the gibberish with very low confidence scores (<0.65 for most blocks) and nonsensical outputs (e.g., 'muc', 'tsruted', mixed Chinese characters '打租出' in an English-style menu). The 'fine_grained_classifier' failing to identify it as a 'menu' (predicting 'envelope' instead) further supports the structural/functional failure. The Router did not miss any major artifacts; the text failure is total.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails the core definition of a 'menu' which requires readable, structured text listing items. The fine_grained_classifier misclassified it as an 'envelope', indicating the visual features do not strongly align with the 'menu' class due to the lack of valid text structure. Only superficial aesthetic checkpoints (theme, color, paper texture) passed. Functional checkpoints (headings, item lists, systematic pricing) all failed. The gibberish text renders the object non-functional as a menu.
artifact_reasoning: Catastrophic text gibberish (Severity 5) dominates the evaluation. The text is not just illegible; it is structurally nonsensical (mixed scripts, random characters). Text alignment is erratic (Severity 3). Edge bleeding on the illustration and text (Severity 2) adds to the artificial look. The perceptual quality auditor noted slight blur, but this is minor compared to the semantic collapse of the text. The artifact score is low (good) only because the non-text areas (paper texture, illustration) are relatively coherent, but the primary function is destroyed.
key_defects: Text Gibberish: Complete lack of readable characters; pseudo-text and mixed scripts.
Functional Failure: No valid item names, prices, or categories.
Typographic Structure Collapse: Inconsistent alignment, spacing, and hierarchy.
Misclassification: Vision classifier identifies it as an envelope, not a menu.
